source.name: Electoral Commission — 2026 General Election timetable
source.page: 2026 General Election Media Kit, p6 (timetable) and p7 (what's new this election)

milestones.label: Last day for Māori who are already enrolled to change roll types
milestones.detail: The deadline to switch between the Māori roll and the general roll for this election.

milestones.label: Candidate nominations open
milestones.detail: Candidates can formally put their names forward from today.

milestones.label: Dissolution of Parliament
milestones.detail: Parliament is dissolved. Sitting MPs stop being MPs and become candidates.

milestones.label: Writ Day
milestones.detail: Enrol by today and voting is straightforward. Anyone who enrols after today casts a special vote, which takes longer to process.

milestones.label: Nominations close for candidates
milestones.detail: The final list of candidates for every electorate is set from here.

milestones.label: Overseas voting starts
milestones.detail: New Zealanders overseas can start voting today.

milestones.label: Last day to enrol to vote in the election
milestones.detail: The final deadline to enrol or update your details. New for 2026: enrolment closes 13 days before election day, so unlike 2023 you cannot enrol once advance voting starts, or on election day. If you are not enrolled by tonight, you cannot vote in this election.

milestones.label: Advance voting starts
milestones.detail: You can vote from today, without waiting for election day. Enrolment is now closed.
milestones.endDateNote: Derived, not listed. The Commission’s timetable gives advance voting a START date only; its 6 November row is "Regulated period ends. All election advertising must end", which is a different thing. The end date follows from p7: "An advance voting period of 12 days is set in the law." Twelve days from 26 October ends 6 November, the day before election day. Recorded here so the derivation is auditable rather than assumed — the same figure was previously typed into two components with no basis given.

milestones.label: Election day
milestones.detail: Voting places are open 9.00am to 7.00pm. Preliminary results are released from 7.00pm.

milestones.label: Official results for the 2026 General Election declared
milestones.detail: The final count, including special votes, is declared today.
